reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 77,000.0, 205.5 points under spot. This is the fourth consecutive session the same floor has been published and the fourth it has gone untested - the lowest wick since the midnight mark is still 77,171.9 at 05:00Z and the lowest settled hourly close is 77,216.7. It is now the tightest it has ever been to price and it has company: the 1Dutc EMA20 has risen to 77,036.0, only 36 points above the gate, so a settled close through 77,000.0 forfeits the daily EMA20 and detonates the 1,853,992 USD long-liquidation cluster in the same move. Below that the next measured reference is 76,880.1 and then 76,001.0.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 77,604.5, the 4H EMA20, 399.0 points over spot. The gate steps DOWN from this morning's 77,669.9 purely because the 4H EMA20 itself fell 65.4 points; the construction is unchanged. It still sits above the 1H EMA50 at 77,482.0, above the 4H EMA100 at 77,554.1 and above the 77,375 to 77,625 short-liquidation band, so one settled close through it clears every overhead average that has capped price since 08 September at once. Today's high of 77,507.1 reached into that band and failed 97.4 points short of the gate, which is exactly the outcome the gate was built to distinguish from a real reclaim.

decisionBox.changed: The headline moves to ADD, and it refers to the SPOT CORE, not to the futures book - a 15.00 USDT tranche of idle cash was deployed into the long-term core at 77,205.5 while the midnight short stays live and untouched. The reason the two are not contradictory is that they answer different questions on different clocks, and today the answers finally diverged cleanly. What changed since this morning is a failed squeeze. Price pushed to 77,507.1 on the 14:00Z bar, reached into the short-liquidation band, and the measured short-side fuel in the 77,500 band went from 155,412 USD at the morning read to 783,048 USD now - a five-fold increase across ten fills. Those shorts were run, and price did not hold the level: it is 301.6 points lower four hours later and has since lost the 1H EMA20 at 77,348.6 and every 15-minute average. A squeeze that fires and fails is the cleanest confirmation a range short gets, and it is why confidence lifts from 5.50 to 6.00 rather than staying flat. Positioning agrees. Funding TRIPLED off the morning reading, from plus 0.0000306030 to plus 0.0000898744647146, back within 3 percent of midnight's level, so longs are paying to be long again; the OKX long/short account ratio is 1.67 after topping at 1.69 on the 13:00Z bar; and swap open interest slipped to 2,117,976,065 USD from 2,122,746,822, minus 0.22 percent. Crowded longs, paying more, with slightly less notional behind them. Against all of that stands the one thing the bears still do not have: the 1H MACD histogram is still POSITIVE at plus 8.01 and the 4H at plus 56.82, so momentum has not rolled over, it has only stopped improving. Neither published gate fired - the high of 77,507.1 missed the 77,669.9 add gate by 162.8 points and the low of 77,199.9 held 199.9 points above the 77,000.0 reduce gate. The spot DCA is the separate decision: the long-term core sits on an average entry of 78,291.7 and is underwater, price is now 169.5 points off the 1Dutc EMA20 rather than this morning's 303, and the daily chart is the only timeframe still above all four of its own averages. Buying the long-term book at the daily EMA20 while a defined-risk tactical short runs into 77,000 is how a two-book desk is supposed to behave.

liquidation.note: 1,853,992 USD of filled long liquidations across 56 fills in the 250-point band centred on 77,000, and 100 percent of it long-side. That is 61.1 percent of all measured liquidation value in the 23-hour window and 82.4 percent of the long-side total. It overlaps the 1Dutc EMA20 at 77,036.0 and the published reduce gate, so one settled close breaks three things simultaneously. It is also the first take-profit on the live futures short.

783,048 USD across 10 fills, 100 percent SHORT-side, and the single biggest change on the day: this band held only 155,412 USD at the 07:08Z morning read. The 14:00Z push to 77,507.1 ran those shorts and then failed to hold - the squeeze fired and the level was rejected. The 1H EMA50 at 77,482.0 and the 4H EMA100 at 77,554.1 both sit inside the band, which is why it keeps capping.

277,168 USD across 13 fills, 273,525 of it long-side. Spot at 77,205.5 has just slipped underneath this band's centre, so the shelf that supported the whole morning is now overhead. Its lower edge at 77,125 is the first thing bulls have to defend.

121,890 USD across 21 fills, all long-side and unchanged since this morning - no new fills reached down here today. Thin next to the 77,000 stack, and the shelf itself was cut through by 749 points on 10 September, so treat it as damaged rather than as support.

scalpContext.intradayBias: One-sided for the first time in three sessions, and the edge is on the short side of the 1H EMA20. Price has lost 77,348.6 and every 15-minute average sits above it in a 113-point band, so anything into 77,345 to 77,360 is selling into resistance rather than buying a dip. The 77,507.1 high is now a confirmed rejection with 783,048 USD of squeezed shorts behind it, which makes it a far harder ceiling than it was this morning. Downside, the first real test is the 77,125 lower edge of the 77,250 band, then the 77,171.9 day low. 15m RSI at 34.29 is the one caution - it is close enough to oversold that chasing the break is worse than fading the retest.

etfFlows.note: Farside Investors US spot Bitcoin ETF tape, re-read in-page at 2026-09-12T12:35 COT. No new row - the last settled session is still 11 September and nothing can settle on a Saturday. The negative streak stands at FOUR: 08 Sep minus 46.6, 09 Sep minus 120.2, 10 Sep minus 282.7, 11 Sep minus 13.2, totalling minus 462.7 million. The 11 September composition is confirmed unchanged on this third read: IBIT minus 19.2, HODL plus 2.2, MSBT plus 3.8, every other fund flat. The decelerating shape is intact and remains the only constructive detail - 46.6, 120.2, 282.7, then a 95 percent collapse to 13.2 without an actual turn. September to date is plus 307.3 million, but strip the single 03 September plus 730.8 print and the month is minus 423.5 million. No creations or redemptions are possible until Monday, so ETF flow is mechanically incapable of moving price across this weekend in either direction - which is precisely why derivatives positioning is carrying the whole signal today.

Swap open interest is 2,117,976,065 USD versus 2,122,746,822 this morning, minus 0.22 percent, and the aggregate BTC open-interest series slipped from 2,822,912,862 at the 15:00Z bar to 2,817,676,706 at 17:00Z. More accounts long, paying more, with marginally less notional behind them - the same crowding as this morning, now with a cost attached and a failed squeeze in front of it.
